friendly_name: Mission-type consolidation into the sanitized model
purpose_context: Part of the 4.0 GA whole-pack round trip (epic #186, issue #194 PR-B). The mission tier of the Charter Packs is spread over mission types, mission definitions, runtime sidecars, action indexes, governance profiles and expected-artifact manifests. It is consolidated into two deliberately designed storage shapes, mission_type and mission_step, each with a schema, read into the charter domain and written back with equal meaning; pinned content is migrated with the service's own writer rather than tolerated.
purpose_tldr: Consolidate the mission tier into two sanitized pack kinds, mission_type and mission_step, and bring them into the whole-pack round trip.
